mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) despite FEDFUNDS rising by >1% over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment below 5.0% strengthens labor market confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite UNRATE crossing below 5.0% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand from both personal consumption (GDPC1) and business investment (RSAFS) signals economic growth, attracting capital to equities and generating positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1 >12,000) combined with supply contraction (INDPRO <95.4) indicates late-cycle expansion, prompting investors to anticipate higher profits and positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive despite late-cycle expansion conditions (GDPC1 >12,000 and INDPRO <95.4) in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS >4%) and improving labor conditions (UNRATE <5%) create uncertainty, leading to negative 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 5d returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS >4.0% and UNRATE <5.0% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Excessive inflation (CPIAUCSL >104) erodes purchasing power, prompting central banks to raise rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 104.0 in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: High employment figures (PAYEMS) reflect a robust labor market, fostering optimism and driving positive 60-day forward returns as investors bet on sustained growth.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive despite PAYEMS increasing by >5% over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS >4%) and supply contraction (INDPRO <84.7) signal economic slowdown, prompting investors to exit equities and generate negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60d returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS >4.0% and INDPRO <84.7 in the same period.
